verdict.rationale: Mistral Document AI is an API service, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an official MCP server or MCP endpoint. The SDKs, llms.txt and markdown docs are adjacent developer resources and do not count as an MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
